title: We Offer Discounts Based on Income
about: A notice to post or hand out: the clinic's sliding fee discount, who qualifies, and that no one is turned away for being unable to pay. HRSA Health Center Program Compliance Manual, chapter 9.

source.name: HRSA Health Center Program Compliance Manual, chapter 9 (patients are told about the sliding fee discount; no one is denied for inability to pay)

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: {facility.name} offers a sliding fee discount. What you pay depends on your household size and income. Your household is you, your spouse or partner, and anyone you support or who supports you.
No one will be denied care because they cannot pay.
Anyone whose household income is at or below the levels below can ask for a discount, with or without health insurance. Ask at the front desk for an application.

blocks.text: Bring proof of income for each person in your household who has income, such as recent pay stubs or last year's tax return. If you have no proof, ask us about signing a statement of your income.
